name: g2_epstau_isi_line
label: ISI three trucks in a line on epsilon Tau: a season of nights at 650 and 900 nm, the diameter and the limb darkening combined
notes: A season (30 nights) on the Hyades red-clump giant with the three trucks in a line: twenty 650 nm nights bracketing the 63 m null and reaching the first and second sidelobes, ten 900 nm nights for the cross-check; the Fisher information on theta and on the linear limb-darkening coefficient u combined (table_combined.md).
The verdict on limb darkening: at the PDM's S/N the sidelobes (|V|^2 ~ 0.01) are not detected in a night, so u stays unconstrained over a season; the diameter reaches ~1 %.
